design_said: Sequential pilot: establish the TRY-A 24-hour baseline before dispatching another thread; vary the hook only after a baseline exists.
owner_decided: Dispatch try-b and try-c on the same day as try-a, before any 24-hour snapshot exists.
consequence: The three threads share a day and an account state; no between-thread comparison from this cohort can separate topic from timing. Their 24/72/168-hour rows are still captured and reported as three baselines, not as an experiment on the hook.
